final: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), grp AS (SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY status), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM grp), shares AS (SELECT g.status, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.tot AS share FROM grp g JOIN total t ON t.tot IS NOT NULL), avgshare AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), diffs AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM shares s JOIN avgshare a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(diff) AS avg_share_diff FROM diffs
